title: Route daemon live log to shared Google Doc
summary: The daemon's live append log must be written to the shared Google Doc (docs.google.com/document/d/1ISxEhP0wdoZjegIgsXCNa6dCjQuJJhiRvzZlkmZPFYQ) instead of the empty cosmos_log.txt in the cosmos_daemon Drive folder. Drive's sign-in wall blocks the assistant from reading private files; the Doc is shared 'anyone with the link' and is fetchable. The .txt file stays as a local mirror only.
scope: proposals only — no execution until accepted through the adversarial pass and Grok Build adjudication
tasks: Retarget the daemon's append writer from cosmos_daemon/cosmos_log.txt to the shared Google Doc via its Docs API or a documented export endpoint.
Keep the .txt as an optional local mirror; do not rely on it as the read path.
Verify the assistant can fetch the Doc contents through the public link after each append.
Log format unchanged: timestamped status lines, one entry per event.
notes: Confirmed working: assistant read 'Test me NOW! NOW! NOW!' from the shared Doc. The .txt in Drive remains empty and unreadable.
